notes.title: Regular update November 5, 2024
notes.content:
We've been cooking up this patch for a large helping of months so far, mostly going over the code for performance improvements with lots of mobs and resources. The game should also look and sound a little nicer!

Import changes:
[list]
[*] Many performance improvements: loading is faster, higher amounts of mobs, resources, animations, and end-game structures impact framerate less
[*] New potion upgrades, raised requirements for all upgrades and made more upgrade useful
[*] New sounds and more sound reactivity
[/list]


Minor changes:
[list]
[*] Mobs and resources are more transparent while building to improve clarity
[*] Merchant and upgrade menus slide in
[*] Bugfixes with liquid refineries, endgame visual bugs fixed
[*] Smoother loads for certain builds
[*] Rearranged menus
[*] The game will ask before it overrides your save
[*] Weapon info is more descriptive
[*] Some parts of tutorial are more intuitive
[*] Functional bug reporter
[/list]

As an aside, if you use Unity and want to chat about optimizing your game, I've set up a google form: https://forms.gle/68Vt1LpHFXJkiswN8

New sounds and more sound reactivity

notes.title: Regular Update Feb 4th
notes.content:
Important changes:
[list]
[*] New potion types & upgrades
[*] Can manually choose the output direction for basic, smart, and electric assemblers using a toggle
[*] Mana "generator" that provides a constant output of mana, as opposed to the inconsistent output of pressure plates
[*] Two new weapon sounds
[*] Three new tracks: Goblin' gems, Death contraption safety inspection, and Beetlejuice Grinder
[/list]

Bugfixes & Performance:
[olist]
[*] New saves should no longer have the bug where some islands do not spawn
[*] Slight performance increase as item count increases
[*] Fixed discord icon, added in wiki to the main page
[/olist]

notes.title: Small Patch Nov 27
notes.content:
Import changes:
- Added a few more steps to the tutorial
- Some types of load crashes have been fixed
- Resource hitbox made smaller (should reduce clogs, but not eliminate them)
- It is possible to build on the entire crystal island now
- Dying now only removes raw item drops

Minor changes:
- Goblin hammer animated while crafting
- Older translations updated
- Minor performance optimizations
- Minor bugfixes
- Chest on spider island gives one more turret
- The game now internally tracks how many times you've beat it (will be important for new game+ content)

We're also developing a wiki here, if you want to contribute: https://mob-factory.fandom.com/wiki/Mob_Factory_Wiki
Many editors good with tables have gotten their hands on it, but we're still missing some important sections.

notes.title: Recent Patches and November Plans
notes.content:
Recent patches have done the following
[list]
[*] New UI toggle for assembler output
[*] More detailed info for how the refinery works
[*] Ghost nerfed, less health
[*] Slimes nerfed  - can only eat one item now
[*] Mimics nerfed - can only eat one item now
[*] Weapons made cheaper
[*] Hydra bullets go less far + are more consistent
[*] Island costs reduced
[*] Final boss costs reduced
[*] Bug reporter moved to the settings menu

[*] Bug fixed where options wouldn't save from the main menu
[*] All weapons should say "requires mana" instead of "electricity" or "magic"
[*] Fixed bridge pickup breaks packs going over multiple islands bug
[*] Hydra bullet bug fixed
[*] Liquid assembler concentration rounding bug fixed
[*] Liquid assembler inconsistency fixed
[*] Fixed pierce no damage/rate of fire on tooltip
[*] Bug where golems would get stuck on a specific tile behind the middle structure fixed
[*] Loading from an old save should be possible on non-english machines that use 1,99 instead of 1.99 for decimal points now
[*] Goal not updating bug fixed
[*] Bug fixed where items & bullets would go through mana pole
[/list]

There is still a rare bug lurking around where all islands will sometimes not generate. We're working on this one and should have a patch out soon. We're also working on an icon on assemblers showing where they will output, a manual toggle so you can choose their output direction, improvements to the tutorial, and a new building or two.

notes.title: Mob Factory is Releasing on November 9th
notes.content:
[h2]Mob Factory is releasing November 9th, 2023[/h2]

We will be keeping the demo on Steam up until a few days before release so you can get your last few hours in. At launch, we'll be selling for $15 USD and ¥58 CNY. 

We sent out our first batch of emails recently, so if you are a content creator you should receive an email in the next day with more info about launch. If you are part of the press and would like to cover the game before release, please reach out to mobfactorygame@gmail.com - though we do get a number of spam offers, so we may or may not be able to get you a key.

notes.title: The Strategy Fest update is now Available
notes.content:
[h2]A major update to the demo is now available on Steam[/h2]

If you've been following on the Itch.io page or the Discord, we had been releasing updates before up until May on the itch page as a Beta.
For the Steam Strategy Fest, we released a big update to give you all something new to chew on.
The current Steam page shows some of the new content and art.

Major changes, since minor ones are too numerous to list:
[list]
[*] The merchant (The cost of weapons scales exponentially)
[*] Four new islands
[*] A boss
[*] Electricity
[*] An inventory
[*] New weapons
[*] Custom music by SO87
[*] Save/load
[*] New utility buildings like the tunneler
[*] Colorization of the art!
[*] A wizard (he has a big hat)
[*] Lots of bugfixes and performance improvements
[/list]

[h3]Crossing 30,000 wishlists[/h3]
We want to give you all a huge thank you for your support - we're currently sitting at ~36,500 Steam wishlists. In no orbit of earth did we expect to have this many eyes on this project. When we launched the store page we were getting 3-4 wishlists a day, and only until the release of the demo did we think there was going to be any kind of interest. In February we then increased the scope by two or three times to meet the new expectations.

[h3]Joining the community[/h3]
If you want to meet other people who play Mob Factory, you have feedback for us, or you want a voice in the direction of the game, join us on the [url=https://discord.gg/nWDFnC4CGN]Discord[/url].

If you want to get in contact with us for business reasons, email us at mobfactorygame@gmail.com

notes.title: The Next Fest Demo is now Available
notes.content:
[h2]The Mob Factory demo is now public[/h2]

Hello everyone. This week, we published the Mob Factory demo and the first patch. Also, some people played our game!  

The changes made in the Day 2 patch include:
[list]
[*] Spanish diacritics should now display correctly
[*] A quit button (We usually deploy to web, where you cannot quit like a desktop app, so we didn't have one until now)
[*] A Vsync button
[*] The bug where Crystal islands would not initialize if you came to them from the top has been fixed (sorry Wanderbots!)
[*] AOE slow should overlap properly now
[*] Items you can't make are now greyed out in assemblers and the crafting menu
[*] Assemblers try not to output into walls, if they can't find a conveyor
[*] Replaced the default tray icon
[/list]

Over the past two days, some people have played the game, and don't seem to hate it? Huh.
[list]
[*] Wanderbots streamed Mob Factory on Twitch
[*] A reddit post hit the front page of r/playmygame
[*] Steam gave the demo a bit of a featuring
[/list]

[h3]Submitting Feedback[/h3]
We are heavily interested in feedback, especially to make the early game and tutorial more accessible. Let us know what you think on our [url=https://discord.gg/nWDFnC4CGN]Discord[/url].

[h3]Getting showcased[/h3]
If you've built a cool base, send a screenshot on our Discord. We might put it in an announcement just like this one.
